rs.innovation_approach: 将独立时间窗的视觉裁剪分配给共享权重子代理并只返回文字摘要；针对温度采样中的格式漂移与无工具捷径，联合格式partial-credit奖励、固定think前缀和每题共享的overview帧预算随机化。
rs.key_step: 同一GRPO组共享随机n，改变可见证据量以产生call/skip结果差；先保持可解析结构，才可能执行和奖励工具行为。
rs.why_non_obvious: 贪心评测格式好不代表训练采样格式好；更强SFT可使工具更不必要、RL调用归零；仅增加调用激励或仅修格式都不能同时稳定两者。
rs.trigger_condition: When a tool-capable model loses parseability under sampled RL and overview observations make skipping tools competitive, anchor schema rewards and randomize observation budgets within prompt groups while exposing parallel-tool demonstrations.

rs.abstract_strategy: Delegate independent observation windows to shared solvers; return compact summaries and train with schema-sensitive rewards under varied initial information budgets.
rs.abstract_key_step: Hold the information budget constant across each comparison group while varying it across groups, and preserve executable structural boundaries.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: A stronger initial solver can eliminate the benefit of acting, while a more active solver can fail to produce executable actions.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When sampled optimization exposes competing structural habits and passive observations erase action benefit, jointly preserve executable structure and vary available evidence to create informative comparisons.

signatures.object: Temporal-window tool interface, SFT traces and main-agent observation stream
signatures.information: Main agent sees overview frames/query and later textual sub-agent summaries. Each sub-agent sees assigned crop window (up to16frames) and shares model weights; complete sub-agent prompt/context permissions not supplied. In trace conversion curator sees sequential tool responses/assistant continuations to check independence.
signatures.operation: Merge adjacent nonoverlapping, non-cross-referencing crops into parallel calls; leave dependent refinements sequential; convert visual tool outputs to text from the existing assistant continuation. At inference dispatch K independent windows to shared-weight sub-agents, concatenate summaries and answer.
signatures.output: 97K-reported cold-start mix and a parallel text-mediated temporal search policy.
signatures.claimed_effect: Same trained checkpoint Table2C: parallel vs sequential VideoMME62.1/69.4 vs61.4/68.8; LongVideoBench60.4 vs57.7; LVBench39.8 vs37.5; MLVU65.0 vs64.1; MMVU68.6 vs66.7. Eq4 estimates~60% main-context input-token reduction atK2.5, not measured whole-system speedup.
conditions: Windows truly independent; sub-agent summaries preserve relevant facts.
SFT supports multi-call syntax; finite serving capacity can constrain concurrency.

evidence.quote:
Within
a single turn, the main agent emits K parallel <tool_call> invocations on disjoint temporal
windows, each dispatched to one of K independent sub-agents that share weights with the main
agent. Each sub-agent grounds only its assigned window, samples a short crop, and returns a textual
summary rather than resampled frames. The gathered summaries are concatenated into a single
<tool_response> block on which the main agent reasons to generate the final <answer>.

signatures.failure_boundary: Dependent refinement cannot be flattened; textual summaries may omit evidence. Peer outvoting is an architectural rationale, no controlled mislocalized-peer intervention or formal voting rule is shown. Shared weights do not prove sub-agent generation tokens receive RL loss; exact gradient inclusion is not disclosed.

limitations.text: Cross-model contrast is observational, not a controlled prior intervention; full method only validatedQwen3-8B.
limitations.quote:
The cross-model evidence for the role of the prior comes from a single Qwen2.5-VL vs. Qwen3-VL
contrast (consistent with a causal interpretation but not equivalent to a controlled intervention), and the
full PARA-GRPO pipeline has only been validated on Qwen3-VL-8B; extending to other tool-native
LMM families and a broader pretraining-prior sweep is future work.

limitations.text: RL gains primarily format/tool stability; standalone greedy-eval gain aboveSFT modest.
limitations.quote:
The RL stage delivers its primary contribution as deployment-time format and
tool-use stability under temperature sampling rather than as a large standalone greedy-eval delta on
top of the cold-started checkpoint; further amplifying the eval-time translation is an open direction.

Only the crop_video
tool is evaluated; whether the recipe generalizes to other tool families (text retrieval, scene-graph
extraction, audio transcription) is open.

question.load_bearing_assumption: A tool-native pretrained model plus format-SFT and generic outcome GRPO will retain executable tool behavior; stronger coldstart/greedy format compliance implies stable sampled exploration.
question.scope: Parallel temporal crop_video inQwen3-VL8B long-video QA/grounding with shared-weight summarizer agents.
question.success_criterion: Improve training-time meanformatreward and maintain nonzero moderate calls while improving held-out64-frame accuracy/mIoU. No registered accuracy-noninferiority/cost limit, no necessity-label evaluation.
question.why_open: Sequential agents accumulate context; standard outcome+format optimization permits skipping when overview suffices and format drift undertemperature leaves tool calls unparsable. Existing token-sparse gradient interventions neglect the structural boundaries needed for execution.

objective.signal_routing: Eq.3/App.B 将任务准确性、格式/anchor 和工具 bonus 合成单个标量，再使用 GRPO 组相对优势。anchor 评分检查特定标签，但正方法未给逐 token 优势或 mask 公式。Think Prefix 在生成时强制，其 actor logprob/mask 未披露；Answer Suffix 是部分格式奖励，不能当作强制终答解码。H.3 的结构 token PG mask 是失败对照。子代理生成 token 是否纳入 RL 损失、工具摘要是否作环境 token，均未明确。
objective.invariance: 不是势函数塑形，也没有最优策略不变定理。格式/工具 bonus 改变奖励偏好；随机 n 改变输入观察和训练分布，固定前缀限制行为支撑。若实现采用标准 mean/std，则组共同常数 bias 被抵消、整体正比例缩放在忽略 epsilon 时被抵消；不能据此推断每个系数都可控。小原始奖励差不必然意味着小归一化优势。单标量相加也不证明格式梯度与内容梯度互不竞争。
objective.baseline_or_potential: 未给显式 critic、反事实价值基线或 potential；组相对奖励基线只作文字描述。无冻结读者必要性 judge。共享权重子代理负责局部视频摘要，GT 标签用于最终任务评分。
objective.degenerate_cases: 全组完整标量奖励相等时没有相对结果信号，零方差数值处理未知；全错仍可能因格式/tool bonus 不同产生梯度，全对的 call/skip 也可能因 bonus 不同而非零差。p(tool)≈0 时未强制采样工具，随机帧预算不能保证支撑；Qwen2.5 与更强 SFT 的零调用是原文反例。n=64 可保持直答充分，n=4 可能连定位线索都缺失，过度稀缺导致过调用。K=1 并行收益消失，K=0 可在思考后直答。固定 opening think 不强制闭合；共享权重摘要错误可以相关，不能保证多数正确。

negative_results.quote:
nFrames Gating alone pushes
κ to 1.36 but leaves fτ stuck at 0.10.

After 160 steps of format-only optimization, fτ remained at
0.13 with no upward trend,

Task-aware shaping improves
training signal quality without translating into held-out eval gains, so we keep the simpler unweighted
accuracy reward in the default recipe.

Subsequent RL from
this Pre-RFT init peaked at fτ =0.40, but the partially-formatted samples in the SFT corpus degraded
the cold-start quality on every downstream metric, ruling out the pre-RL refinement route.

RL
from this stronger init produces zero tool calls throughout training.

After 11 steps, fτ dropped to 0.11 (below baseline 0.13): zeroing
gradients on format tokens tells the model format is irrelevant to reward, the opposite of what
stabilizing format requires.

The <tool_code>-trained model still generates <tool_call> in 5.4% of
rollouts (despite never seeing it during SFT), while its trained <tool_code> appears in only
1.8%.

evidence_design.falsifier: 读者提出、未执行：固定采样温度、prompt、GT 和 parser，核对强制前缀的行为支撑与 logprob；比较帧预算 gating、匹配的随机视觉破坏和全帧输入，报告分任务 call/skip 奖励与方差及独立必要性标签。如果收益仅来自人为隐藏信息或格式 bonus，不能支持全预算真实必要性结论。用相同窗口/摘要、总像素和模型 token 比较并行/串行，实测 wall time；注入错误子代理后再判断容错。

engineering.lesson: 当贪心输出合规但训练温度下结构标签崩溃时，先用真实rollout按标签统计解析率并核对强制前缀的采样/打分一致性；不要把全轨迹格式奖励误当成局部token信用，也不要用降低初始视觉信息量来替代真实必要性验证。

relevance.how: 格式/工具奖励进入groupnormalization，缺完整公式；不能直接证明小系数可控或小rawgap等于小advantage。
相反失败方向：该任务skiptool塌缩，我们常见alwayscrop；同为结果奖励和采样支撑耦合，不可照搬工具加分。
结构奖励依赖parseability，但未给逐调用因果信用，也未定义局部优势mask。
ThinkPrefix改变行为支撑；注入前缀的actor打分/屏蔽需要核对。
SFT并行示范必需但更强SFT反使工具归零；示范比例与行为支撑有关。
tool概率塌缩与格式崩溃相互作用；随机帧预算不保证动作支撑。
把独立序列工具合并平行示范，仅dependencycheck通过才可重组。
主代理用文字summary作证据，没有summary真实性独立奖励；仍可能写对/读错或summary幻觉。
没有种子/CI；多checkpoint不替代复现。
解析失败、partialcredit和fallback答案抽取改变奖励总体；需审计真实tokenmask。
并行分发+文本回传节约主上下文，不自动降低总计算/墙钟。
AReaL异步但策略陈旧/IS纠正细节不披露，迁移需核对。
按观测预算制造训练异质性，不是按真实工具收益选择题。
它优化工具可用性/格式稳定性，不等同于我们准确率非劣下少裁图。

measurement_and_source_audit.format_units: fτ 是训练格式奖励均值，完整方法为 .41；.64 是峰值，不能写作平均或64%可解析率。Table 5 标签闭合率使用冷启动N=166及训练N=56；tool-call率18.2/9.5/31.7/52.6%并非56的整数计数比例，条件分母不清，保留原值不反推计数。κ=.21调用/rollout 与 Figure7 的14.4%任意工具标签使用率不同；parsed calls 和 tags 的定义/总体未完全对齐。
measurement_and_source_audit.information_boundary: 默认 RL 不用 learned judge 或 necessity oracle。准确率按 MCQ exact match、temporal IoU、OE token F1 对 GT；格式评分读生成结构。三层 fallback 答案抽取可在标签不完美时给准确性奖励，因此 malformed 不等于自动零奖励（明确的早期退化输出例外）。随机帧预算制造信息不足，但不标注单次调用必要性；局部代理读裁剪帧，主代理读摘要文本。
